Chromium 138 in this container crashed on a minimal data URL as well as the submission, so no Chromium-specific runtime claim is made; the submission HTML contains no JavaScript.

accessibility.notes: zh-CN/en present on all four documents.
92/92 image instances resolve and have non-empty descriptive alt text.
No h-level jump in any document.
All proposal tables include header cells and preserve source order.
No unnamed link; language-switch links have aria-labels.
Contact-sheet and full-size review found no unreadable low-contrast body text or clipped labels.
Documents are static; all interactive elements are native anchors in DOM order.
No claim of fully tagged-PDF conformance; visual order, embedded fonts, captions and page structure were checked.
